photos.desc: A pair of Klipspringers in the highlands of Oromia region, southern Ethiopia
Klipspringer (Oreotragus oreotragus) on granite rocks at Spitzkoppe, Namibia
Digiscoping with Swarovski ATM 80 HD 30 X, Coolpix P5100 (Adapter DCB)
The word klipspringer literally means "rock jumper" in Afrikaans/Dutch. The klipspringer is also known colloquially as a mvundla (from the Xhosa umvundla, meaning "rabbit").
